summary: Casper Orthopedics, a Wyoming orthopedic practice, discovered a cyberattack on or about May 23, 2026. Its investigation concluded June 11 that unauthorized parties may have accessed Social Security numbers, financial account information, medical records and driver's license numbers. It reported 56,197 affected individuals to HHS on July 23, 2026. The Anubis ransomware group claimed the attack on July 12, 2026; Casper has not confirmed the attribution.
